body:
### Problem

Nvim aborts on an assertion in `grid_line_flush()` while handling a UI resize.
The crash happened in a real session (not a synthetic test) running inside the
[Herdr](https://herdr.dev) terminal multiplexer, at the moment a second client
attached to the same session with a different window size, which made Herdr push
a resize to every pane.

```
nvim: /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/grid.c:595: grid_line_flush:
      Assertion `grid_line_clear_to <= grid_line_maxcol' failed.
```

Command line of the crashed process: `nvim --embed -c 'Neotree show'`
(the embedded server half of the normal TUI; the resize arrived over RPC as
`nvim_ui_try_resize`).

Note the width in frame #11: `screen_resize (width=25, ...)`. The pane the
editor lived in was 321 columns wide before the resize, so this was a large
shrink to a very narrow width. The window being drawn when the assertion fired
is drawn with `hl=HLF_EOB` (the end-of-buffer filler), `endrow=15`.

Full backtrace, symbolized against the Arch debuginfod server:

```
#0  __pthread_kill_implementation (threadid=<optimized out>, signo=signo@entry=6, no_tid=no_tid@entry=0) at pthread_kill.c:44

#6  __assert_fail (assertion=assertion@entry=0x559050316740 "grid_line_clear_to <= grid_line_maxcol", file=file@entry=0x559050316658 "/usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/grid.c", line=line@entry=595, function=function@entry=0x559050357130 <__PRETTY_FUNCTION__.3> "grid_line_flush") at assert.c:37
#7  0x000055904ff3c278 in grid_line_flush () at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/grid.c:595
#8  0x000055904ffe9ad6 in win_draw_end (wp=wp@entry=0x55906c8483b0, c1=32, draw_margin=draw_margin@entry=false, startrow=<optimized out>, endrow=15, hl=hl@entry=HLF_EOB) at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/drawscreen.c:2555
#9  0x000055904ffead80 in win_update (wp=<optimized out>) at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/drawscreen.c:2411

#13 0x00005590502aa7c3 in ui_refresh () at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/ui.c:245
#14 0x000055904ff6b9cd in nvim_ui_try_resize (channel_id=<optimized out>, width=<optimized out>, height=<optimized out>, err=0x7ffd5c7f5b20) at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/api/ui.c:290
#15 handle_nvim_ui_try_resize (channel_id=<optimized out>, args=..., arena=<optimized out>, error=0x7ffd5c7f5b20) at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/build/src/nvim/auto/api/private/dispatch_wrappers.generated.h:6913

#21 0x0000559050260b08 in state_enter (s=0x7ffd5c7f5e10) at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/state.c:100
#22 0x000055904ff43670 in normal_enter (cmdwin=false, noexmode=false) at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/normal.c:522
#23 main (argc=<optimized out>, argv=<optimized out>) at /usr/src/debug/neovim/neovim/src/nvim/main.c:692
```

This looks closely related to #33883, which had the same call chain
(`nvim_ui_try_resize` -> `ui_refresh` -> `screen_resize` -> `update_screen` ->
`win_update` -> `win_draw_end` -> grid.c assertion) and the same trigger
(shrinking the screen width). That one asserted on
`(size_t)grid_line_maxcol <= linebuf_size` in `screengrid_line_start` and was
closed for the 0.12 milestone. This is a different assertion in the same path,
still present in 0.12.5.

### Steps to reproduce

I have not been able to reduce this to a reliable recipe, and I would rather say
so than post a recipe that does not work. What I tried, all in a pty whose size
I changed with `TIOCSWINSZ`, none of which reproduced it:

- `nvim --clean -c 'let i=1 | while i<100 | wincmd v | endwhile'` (the repro from
  #33883), then shrinking the width one column at a time from 200 down to 12,
  then the height from 45 down to 4.
- The same with horizontal splits, and with a mix of both.
- The real config with neo-tree open, 120 rounds of fast random resizes between
  4x8 and 60x240, six different seeds.
- The real config with neo-tree open, bouncing between 55x321 and 16xN for every
  N from 40 down to 10, plus ten repeats at the width from the backtrace (25),
  four runs.

So it appears to need timing or state I have not managed to recreate. The
backtrace above is from the real crash and is complete; the core dump still
exists locally if any specific value from it would help.

### Expected behavior

No crash on resize.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.12.5, Build type: RelWithDebInfo, LuaJIT 2.1.1788460057 (Arch package neovim 0.12.5-1)

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

no

### Operating system/version

Arch Linux (Omarchy), kernel 7.2.3-arch1-3, Wayland/Hyprland 0.56.2

### Terminal name/version

foot 1.28.0, with Herdr 0.8.2 as the multiplexer between the terminal and nvim

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

Arch `extra` repository package

comment_data.body: If you're able to reproduce this fairly reliably, can you please try nightly? Either [build from master](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/BUILD.md#quick-start), or get a build from the [Releases](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/tag/nightly) page. Check `:version` to confirm the version.

title: Crash on UI resize: assertion grid_line_clear_to <= grid_line_maxcol in grid_line_flush
